context7.description: Live library documentation — Spring Boot, Avro, Kafka, Testcontainers, Resilience4j. Use before answering questions about any library API.

github.description: GitHub MCP — read PRs, issues, CI status. Active in all modules.
github.note: Requires GITHUB_TOKEN env var with repo scope.

postgres.description: Postgres MCP — inspect live schema, indexes, row counts before writing migrations.
postgres.note: Set POSTGRES_MCP_URL=postgresql://user:pass@localhost:5432/dbname. Active in order-service, payment-service, notification-service.

schema-registry.description: Confluent Schema Registry MCP — query registered Avro schemas, check compatibility.
schema-registry.note: Set SCHEMA_REGISTRY_MCP_URL. Active in common-events, any service producing Kafka events.
schema-registry.status: optional — connect only if Schema Registry MCP server is deployed

jira.description: Jira MCP — read ticket descriptions, acceptance criteria, and linked subtasks.
jira.note: Set JIRA_MCP_URL and JIRA_TOKEN. inject-git-context.sh extracts issue number from branch name.
jira.status: optional — connect if team uses Jira

usage.note: context7 applies to all modules — omitted from module_mapping for brevity
usage.how_to_activate: Add server names to .claude/settings.json under 'mcpServers' or use Claude Code's /mcp command.
